description: The pie chart is divided into two main categories: Virtual Characters and Real Characters, with a further subdivision of Real Characters into Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters. Virtual Characters are represented by a light blue slice, while Real Characters are shown in a green slice. Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters are all subcategories of Real Characters, each represented by a different shade of green. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any visual emphasis on specific slices. The segments are ordered in a clockwise direction starting from Comic Characters at the top, moving through the subcategories of Real Characters, and then to Virtual Characters at the bottom.
